function.name: Read
function.description: Read a text file in the workspace. Returns its lines, each with its line number. Use offset and limit to read part of a large file. Temporary files go in the scratch directory, <scratch>, by absolute path: they need no effect, and are removed when the run ends.

file_path.description: The file, relative to the workspace, such as src/a.py.

offset.description: The first line to read, from 1.

function.name: Write
function.description: Create a file, or replace a whole file, with the content given. Missing directories are made. To change part of a file, use Edit. Temporary files go in the scratch directory, <scratch>, by absolute path: they need no effect, and are removed when the run ends.

file_path.description: The file, relative to the workspace.

content.description: The whole of the file's new content.

function.name: Edit
function.description: Replace old_string with new_string in a file. old_string must occur exactly once, unless replace_all is true. Temporary files go in the scratch directory, <scratch>, by absolute path: they need no effect, and are removed when the run ends.

file_path.description: The file, relative to the workspace.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: Glob
function.description: List the files whose paths match a pattern: * matches within one part of a path, ? one character, and ** any number of parts, as in src/**/*.py. Temporary files go in the scratch directory, <scratch>, by absolute path: they need no effect, and are removed when the run ends.

path.description: The directory to search, relative to the workspace.

function.name: Grep
function.description: Search files for lines matching a regular expression (Python's syntax). Returns each match as path:line:text. Temporary files go in the scratch directory, <scratch>, by absolute path: they need no effect, and are removed when the run ends.

path.description: A file or directory to search, relative to the workspace.

glob.description: Only search files whose paths match this pattern.

function.name: Delete
function.description: Delete one file. Temporary files go in the scratch directory, <scratch>, by absolute path: they need no effect, and are removed when the run ends.

file_path.description: The file, relative to the workspace.

function.name: Move
function.description: Move or rename one file. The destination must not exist yet; missing directories are made. Temporary files go in the scratch directory, <scratch>, by absolute path: they need no effect, and are removed when the run ends.

source.description: The file to move, relative to the workspace.

destination.description: Where it goes, relative to the workspace.
